'''Andi Whaley''' (born 1 July 1978) is an American voice actress was one of the original voice actresses for the English-language dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Pokémon==
Whaley started voicing characters on Pokémon during {{aniseries|RS}}. Her most famous role was that of [[Cassidy]], who had previously been voiced by [[Megan Hollingshead]]. For that role, Whaley was eventually replaced with [[Emily Williams]].
